svg.title: Morocco: advertising cost per qualified respondent in three city radius areas
svg.desc: Radius areas of 10 miles (16 km) around Casablanca, Fez, Marrakesh, drawn to scale. Ad cost per qualified respondent: Casablanca $2.79, Marrakesh $6.53, Fez $8.70; all three $5.39.
svg.text: MOROCCO · THREE CITIES, 16 KM RADIUS AREAS
11 Dec 2025 – 11 Jan 2026, 9 days of advertising. Each radius area is a Meta city target with a 10-mile radius;
the city points are placed from GeoNames (Meta stores the city, not its point). Men and women and
